content.title: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Solana payment

Selling digital products has become an essential revenue stream for creators worldwide, yet many face barriers due to payment platform restrictions. This is particularly true for creators in regions like Nigeria and Zimbabwe, where popular services are often inaccessible. By utilizing Solana payments processed through NOWPayments, creators can accept cryptocurrency seamlessly, ensuring that their products reach a global audience without the burden of traditional payment fees. This shift not only enhances accessibility but also places the power back in the hands of the creators.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The architecture of a Solana-based payment solution is robust and efficient. It integrates with NOWPayments, which supports over 300 cryptocurrencies, allowing for real-time payment processing with minimal fees. The infrastructure relies on Cloudflare Workers for backend logic, enabling instant verification and delivery of digital products. This setup eliminates the reliance on conventional payment gateways, ensuring that transactions are swift, secure, and cost-effective. The use of Solana, a high-speed blockchain, further enhances transaction efficiency, making it suitable for creators with high sales volumes.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This solution is specifically designed for digital creators in regions where traditional payment platforms fail to provide reliable services. Whether you’re selling ebooks, courses, or digital assets like templates and fonts, this architecture allows you to transact freely and efficiently. It empowers creators from countries like Ghana, Pakistan, and Venezuela to reach a wider audience without the constraints imposed by conventional payment systems. By removing these barriers, it fosters creativity and entrepreneurship, enabling creators to thrive in a digital economy.
Keep more of your earnings with 0.5% payment fees.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The foundation of this payment architecture consists of several key components. At its core is NOWPayments, which facilitates cryptocurrency transactions with only a 0.5% fee. Complementing this is Cloudflare Workers for executing backend logic and Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for secure file delivery. Additionally, the integration with GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages allows for hosting your digital storefront at no cost. Together, these components create a seamless experience for both the seller and the buyer, ensuring that every transaction is processed smoothly and efficiently.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To get started with deploying your own sovereign payment solution, first select the right infrastructure stack from the Complete Builder Kit, which includes essential blueprints and templates. Next, set up your digital storefront using GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Then, configure Cloudflare Workers for your payment logic, integrating NOWPayments for cryptocurrency transactions. Finally, upload your digital products to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for automated delivery. This process not only establishes your online presence but also ensures that you retain control over your sales and customer data.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

You can sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe by utilizing cryptocurrency payment processors like NOWPayments. This service allows you to accept payments in various cryptocurrencies without the need for traditional banking systems. With minimal fees and no buyer accounts required, it streamlines the selling process for digital products.
Gain full control over your sales and customer data.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

For those looking to dive deeper into this new payment paradigm, consider exploring the Complete Builder Kit ($197) available at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html. This kit provides everything you need to build and scale your digital commerce stack, ensuring you are fully equipped to operate independently of conventional payment platforms.
Your Deployment Checklist

Prepare your product files in delivery-ready format — PDF for ebooks, ZIP archives for multi-file products, exported files for Notion templates, OTF and TTF archives for font families. Set your prices in USD and let NOWPayments handle the crypto equivalent calculation automatically at transaction time. Deploy your stack and configure the product list with file paths, USD prices, and delivery settings. Configure your storefront with product pages and checkout flow. Test the checkout on both desktop and mobile — confirm QR codes generate correctly and live price feeds display accurately. Complete a real mainnet test transaction and confirm the delivery email arrives with a working download link. Check your order database and confirm the test transaction appears with all correct fields.
Frequently Asked Questions
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

You can sell an ebook online by using cryptocurrency payment processors like NOWPayments. This allows you to accept payments directly in cryptocurrencies without needing traditional banking services, thereby avoiding the restrictions of PayPal and Stripe.
What is the best way to sell digital downloads without platform fees?

The best way to sell digital downloads without platform fees is to utilize a sovereign architecture that includes NOWPayments for payment processing. With fees as low as 0.5%, you can maximize your profits while maintaining full control over your sales.
Can I sell templates and fonts without using Gumroad or Payhip?

Yes, you can sell templates and fonts without relying on Gumroad or Payhip by using your own digital storefront powered by Cloudflare Pages and NOWPayments. This approach allows you to keep more of your earnings and maintain complete control over your products.
What are the advantages of using Solana for payments?

Solana offers several advantages for payments, including low transaction fees and high-speed processing. This makes it an ideal choice for digital creators who need efficient and cost-effective payment solutions for their products.
How do I ensure secure file delivery after payment?

To ensure secure file delivery, integrate your payment processor with tools like Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. This setup allows for automated delivery of digital products immediately upon payment confirmation, ensuring a smooth customer experience.
